title: Book content (tang 0, v0.9.0 – D2 da chot)
description: Noi dung mot cuon sach so. Che do nen cua moi cuon la 'trang goc + ghim' (pages + pins). Lop 'bai hoc' dung lessons[].blocks; lop 'doc van' dung reading + cac khoi poem/prose. Gia tri 'kind' cua bai tap (^ex\.) lay tu thu-vien/bai-tap/danh-muc.json; cua mo phong (^sim\.) lay tu thu-vien/mo-phong/danh-muc.json. Schema khong liet ke enum cung cho hai loai nay.

schema_version.description: 0.9.0 = sau D2 (18/11/2026); '0.9' (ban nhap) van hop le de tuong thich.

asset_sources.description: Nguon tai nguyen ngoai artifact cua cuon, khoa = ten nguon dung trong tien to '@<nguon>/' cua asset_path. D2.

grading_defaults.description: Cach cham mac dinh cua ca cuon (ghi de bang exercise.grading.rule). D2: accept_v2 la mac dinh chung; cuon Toan/Ly/Hoa co the dat accept_v2_math (van doi dau nhay ve ‘).

ui_strings.description: Chuoi giao dien rieng cua cuon (vd. hang U o matematika5). Chuoi dung chung thuoc tang 0 giao dien.

translation_memory.description: RUDICT. D2: giu (tuy chon) de tuong thich; buoc 4 uu tien do ru thang vao chuoi i18n.

id.description: Id BEN (D2): lay tu khoa noi dung – so bai/so hinh in tren sach (p21.q5, p37.rasm4), khoa goc cua ma (t4, l11, u2.1) – KHONG dung chi so vi tri trong mang (ex0, fig0). Id cu ghi vao legacy_ids.

box.description: Khung tren anh trang theo % [x, y, w, h] (goc tren-trai). Dung chung cho tr.b, ex.b, fig.b, WBGEO.b, GEO.tbl.

page_crop.description: Cat vung tu anh trang (crop [trang,x,y,w,h] o tabiiy5/adabiyot5; v.k='img' o TP).

i18n.description: Chuoi da ngu. uz bat buoc; ru, vi, kaa tuy chon. Cho phep danh dau noi dong: **dam** (tabiiy5), {tu/mau} phan so (matematika5).

sentence.description: Don vi van ban co the doc to: chuoi da ngu + tham chieu doan audio (adabiyot5 {uz,vi,ru,f,a,na}; tabiiy5/biologiya5 khoi co audio).

no_read.description: na=1: khong doc trong che do bai hoc

ref_ex.description: Gia tri hop le lay tu thu-vien/bai-tap/danh-muc.json

ref_sim.description: Gia tri hop le lay tu thu-vien/mo-phong/danh-muc.json

profile.description: Thay window.BOOK_PROFILE {title,subject,grade,age} va mo rong. Gia su chi doc tu day.

subject.description: Ma mon tieng Anh nhu BOOK_PROFILE.subject (chemistry, natural science, literature...)

subject_id.description: Ma mon snake_case (mathematics, natural_science, literature...). Gia su chon subject_rules theo truong nay. Thieu thi dau doc suy tu subject (tuong thich). D2.

grade_band.$comment: Enum truc sinh tu tang0/tu-dien-truc.json bang _cong-cu/sinh-enum.py; sua tu dien roi chay lai, KHONG sua tay. (grade_band, audience, lang_base, $defs/lang)

audience.description: Sach hoc sinh hay sach giao vien

lang_base.description: Ngon ngu cua ban in goc

langs.description: Cac ngon ngu co trong du lieu chu

country.description: Ten nuoc cua bo sach bang tieng Anh, dien vao loi nhac gia su (vd. 'Uzbekistan'); khong viet cung trong mau. D2.

tutor_persona.description: Nhan vat gia su (ten cu; dung tutor.persona – giu de tuong thich)

tutor.description: Cau hinh gia su cua cuon; gia-su/prompts.json doc profile.tutor.*. D2.

persona_origin.description: Ghi de cau mo ta nhan vat khi sach khong co nhan vat nay

subject_scope.description: Cum mo ta pham vi cau hoi (mac dinh suy tu subject)

software_list.description: Chi sach Tin: phan mem sach dung

print_editions.description: Ban in co anh trang (uz, ru song song...)

layout_from.description: Bo cuc trang lay tu ban in nao (biologiya5: ru)

volumes.description: SGK + vo bai tap trong cung mot cuon (matematika5 BK='tb'|'wb'; tabiiy5 pages/ + wbpages/).

unit.description: Chuong / mo-dun / don vi (CH, BOOK.chapters, DATA.units[].meta).

kind.description: adabiyot5 meta.kind: intro|poem|prose|... ; khac de trong

lesson.description: Bai / chu de. Sach ho A (TP: b0/i*/t*/s*) chi co tham chieu video/quiz/hoat dong; sach co lop 'bai hoc' them blocks.

kind.description: TP.kind (null = lesson) D2: giu chu de TP (b0/i*/t*/s*) la lessons[] co kind, khong tach topics.

block.description: Khoi cua lop 'bai hoc' va 'doc van'. 'type' = dang noi dung (truc 3); 'rubric' = ten muc cua bo sach (truc 2, anh xa o tri-thuc/rubric-bo-sach.json).

rubric.description: Ma muc goc: objectives, think, explore, learn, career, problem, robot, skills, keywords, questions, task, lab, pre, know, talk, bio, p...

scenes.description: Phim tranh (sim.picture_story) chen theo doan: at = chi so doan

page.description: Mot trang ban in. Che do nen: anh trang + vung dich tr + ghim pins.

n.description: So thu tu anh trang (khoa cua PG/HOT/WBGEO)

images.description: Anh trang theo ngon ngu ban in: {uz:'pages/p021.jpg', ru:'@ru_pages/pages_ru/p021.jpg'} (ban in thu hai o artifact dong hanh – D2)

background.description: Anh nen da xoa chu (adabiyot5 bg/) cho 'trang dung lai chu that'

text_lines.description: Lop chu that (LN_.pg / PG.pg o biologiya5): [x, y, w, size, style_idx, text, anchor_idx, anchor_id?] theo he toa do print_text. anchor_id (phan tu 8, tuy chon, D2) = id trong reading.anchors; dau doc uu tien anchor_id, thieu thi ghep theo duoi so cua id (cach cu).

ocr.description: Van ban OCR ban in khac theo trang (RUTXT)

ink.description: Cho phep ve muc tren trang (vo tabiiy5)

pin.description: Ghim / diem cham tren trang (PG.pin, HOT, WBS->ghim wb, PG.figs, PG.end, GEO.anch).

field.description: O nhap dat tren anh trang (WBI, WBGEO + item.paper, GEO.tbl, GEO.wl, cho trong '– …').

item_key.description: WBI '<i>.<j>' hoac chi so o bang

print_text.description: He toa do + kieu chu + doan cua lop 'trang dung lai chu that' (biologiya5 PG.W/H/st/T; adabiyot5 LN_.st).

styles.description: [bold, italic, color] hoac [font, bold, italic, color]

role.description: T.k: h | '' | cap# | lab | kw | gw

question.description: T.a: doan la cau hoi, mo o tra loi

reading.description: Lop 'doc van': doc theo cau, audio theo cau, noi dong chu tren trang voi cau.

audio_groups.description: SPR: nhom audio (f) -> danh sach id clip theo chi so cau (a) D2: du thua voi sentence.audio_ref; tuy chon, giu de tuong thich, du lieu moi khong bat buoc.

anchors.description: HOT adabiyot5: [page, x%, y%, unitIdx, blockIdx, key] -> diem cham nghe + xem dich

exercise.description: Bai tap. 'kind' lay tu thu vien bai tap; cac truong du lieu cu the theo data_shape cua kind do. Item co the ghi de kind (vd. y tra loi ngan va y tu luan trong cung mot bai).

id.description: Id ben (README 'Quy uoc id'). Bai theo so in: <tap><trang>[.<series>].q<slug so in>, vd. p21.q5, p21.m4.q1, p166.test.q1, p55.g2.q1, p58.q1_misol. Id ma goc giu nguyen (t4.quiz, l11.sort, u2.1.8). Kiem: schema/_tools/id_ben.py

no.description: So in nguyen van ('★', '1-misol', '4.1'); q-token cua id = slug(no)

audio_ref.description: Khoa media.clips doc de bai (nha may: media.exercise_prompt_audio). D2 theo de xuat M2.

image.description: Anh cua the (thay data.card_images ghep theo thu tu – D2 theo de xuat R2)

cell_options.description: ex.table_fill: phuong an chon cho o (FUNCS cua tabiiy5); dap an cua hang = items[].correct (chi so). D2 theo de xuat R2.

role.description: id vai tro trong gia-su/prompts.json. 'feedback' (= open_feedback) va 'score' (= open_grade) la bi danh cu, khong dung cho du lieu moi (D2).

supplementary.description: Khong co trong sach in (quiz bo sung adabiyot5)

data.description: Truong rieng cua kind chua chuan hoa (vd. flowers, bank, rows dac thu WB)

answer.description: Dap an chap nhan, phuong an thay the noi bang '|', nhieu o noi bang ';'. Cham mac dinh accept_v2 (D2): chu thuong, moi dau nhay ' ` ʻ ’ ʼ doi ve ‘, gop khoang trang, so so voi dung sai 1e-6.

answer_pattern.description: Regex kw (tabiiy5 WB) dung cham du phong

simulation.description: Mo phong / mo hinh / cong cu ao / kich ban thao tac phan mem dat trong cuon (ACT, TP.model, DM...).

params.description: Theo 'params' cua kind trong thu vien mo phong

exercise_ref.description: Neu mo phong co phan cham (du doan - kiem tra)

video.description: 'Video' hoat hinh dung bang ma (trinh phat sim.scene_player): chuoi canh {tieu de, loi thuyet minh, hinh}; hinh moi canh la mot sim.* trong thu vien mo phong.

visual.description: Hinh cua canh: mo phong sim.* (vd. sim.scene_page_image = cat anh trang, sim.scene_custom_draw = ham draw ve tay chua tham so hoa, sim.atom_shells...) hoac anh tinh. Ca video do sim.scene_player phat.

figure.description: Kham pha hinh co diem danh so (PG.fig, BOOK figure.xp, mountFlower PARTS).

src.description: Anh rieng (img/fN.jpg) neu khong cat tu trang

labels.description: Nhan co san tren hinh (bieu do nhan, che do do nhan)

workbook_set.description: Bo bai vo bai tap gan voi bai SGK (WBS matematika5, WB.sections tabiiy5).

kind.description: subtitle = WebVTT (D2, nha may media media.subtitles)

bitrate_kbps.description: Audio giao: 64 kbps (D2). File cu (vd. audio_vi ~32 kbps) giu nguyen toi khi sinh lai.

used.description: false = co trong goi nhung ma khong tham chieu (vd. tabiiy5 audio/)

clips.description: Doan audio theo ngon ngu (AUDIO.vi, SPRITE, SPR). Khoa = id clip.

fallback_tts.description: Ngon ngu khong co clip thi dung speechSynthesis

render_hash.description: source_hash cua phieu/bien ban nha may media (bam media_type, lang, text_hash, giong, format_profile, lexicon, pipeline). Lech = can render lai du chu khong doi. D2 theo de xuat M2.

text_path.description: Con tro JSON toi chuoi duoc doc (de nha may media sinh lai)

source_hash.description: sha256 cua chuoi nguon (UTF-8, NFC) tai thoi diem sinh media; lech = audio cu, nha may media can sinh lai

forms.description: Dang bien to cua term o ngon ngu ban goc (lang_base) da gap trong van ban, de gach chan/khop chu giai (vd. 'unguridagi' cua 'Ungur'). D2 theo de xuat R3.

audio_ref.description: Khoa media.clips doc thuat ngu (nha may: media.term_audio). D2 theo de xuat M2.

teacher.description: Lop du lieu cua giao vien: ghi de dung chung (db), giao bai (hw/), ket qua lop (res/), GV cham (grade/). D2: giao bai + ket qua cho ca 7 cuon.

media_overrides.description: db media/<id> (__VM): video that thay hoat hinh theo ngon ngu

content_overrides.description: db edit/<key> (biologiya5) va quiz/<id> (adabiyot5): an/hien khoi, sua cau hoi, them bo quiz/nut video, sua diem hinh

assignments.description: db hw/<set> (mau matematika5). D2: ca 7 cuon.

results.description: db res/<set>_<uid>: ket qua hoc sinh day len (class_result); learner_state cu van hop le.

grades.description: db grade/<set>_<uid>: diem va nhan xet cua GV (D2).

learner_state.description: Trang thai hoc sinh (hien chi o localStorage cac cuon; cung hinh dang khi day len db res/).

translation_memory.description: Tu dien chuoi nguon -> chuoi dich (RUDICT). Chi dung khi nhap lieu; buoc 4 phai do ban dich vao tung chuoi i18n.

asset_path.description: Duong dan tai nguyen. Mac dinh tuong doi voi artifact cua cuon. Tien to '@<nguon>/' = file nam o asset_sources.<nguon> (vd. '@ru_pages/pages_ru/p021.jpg' = artifact dong hanh chua anh trang ban in Nga). Dau doc giai qua T0.asset(). D2.

asset_source.description: Mot nguon tai nguyen ngoai artifact cua cuon. D2: dung cho anh trang ban in thu hai (pages_ru/) de goi chinh <= 256 MB khi audio 64 kbps.

kind.description: self = chinh artifact cuon; companion_artifact = artifact dong hanh; url = nguon ngoai co dinh

url.description: Goc URL cua nguon (vd. link artifact dong hanh); null khi chua publish

edition.description: Ban in co anh trang o nguon nay (vd. ru)

fallback_base.description: Tien to dung khi url chua co (ban xem truoc / phat trien). '' = cung thu muc voi cuon.

media_lang.description: Ngon ngu cua media; zxx = khong co noi dung ngon ngu (sfx, anh). D2.

grading.description: Ghi de cach cham cua kind (mac dinh lay trong thu-vien/bai-tap/danh-muc.json: grading.default_rule).

rule.description: id quy tac trong thu vien bai tap: accept_v2 (mac dinh dap an ngan, D2), accept_v2_math, nrm_v1 (bi danh cu = accept_v2_math), per_position (mac dinh ex.order, D2), all_or_nothing...

teacher_review.description: Dua bai vao hang cho GV cham trong bang ket qua lop (truc 5 giao_vien, bat o v1 – D2)

legacy_ids.description: Id cu (theo vi tri 'p21.ex0', hoac id tam truoc quy tac 015 nhu 'p22.q1-2', 'p151.q1_2', 'p8.q1.1', 'p1.chizma.<slug>') truoc khi doi sang id ben; dung de chuyen trang thai hoc sinh/khoa luu cu (de xuat 014).

assignment.description: db hw/<set_id> (matematika5 setHW: {on, due}). D2: dung cho ca 7 cuon.

assigned.description: Ten cu cua on (v0.9 nhap) – giu de tuong thich

target.description: id muc duoc giao (mac dinh = khoa)

class_result.description: db res/<set>_<uid>: hoc sinh day ket qua (matematika5 pushRes, debounce 1,5 s). D2: ca 7 cuon.

answers.description: Bai lam (bat buoc voi y mo de GV cham)

teacher_grade.description: db grade/<set>_<uid>: GV cham y mo (truc 5 giao_vien, bat o v1 – D2). Chi GV (user.canEdit) ghi.

exercise_series.description: Nhom/day bai in ma bai thuoc vao (de xuat 015, D3). Token trong id: mashq -> m<no>, test -> test, amaliy -> amaliy, misol -> misol; group>=2 -> g<group> (ghep sau token co ten, vd. m9.g2); main/warmup/other khong co token rieng. Chi ghi khi khac nhom chinh thu nhat cua trang.

kind.description: main = cau hoi/bai chinh cua bai hoc; mashq = 'N-mashq'; test = test on chuong; amaliy = 'N-amaliy ish'; misol = vi du mau; warmup = bai khoi dong; other = day khac (vd. 'laboratoriya ishi', 'Nazorat ishi', 'Progress check')

group.description: Nhom khong ten thu k tren cung trang (so in bat dau lai), token g<k>

title.description: Tieu de day in tren sach (vd. '2- AMALIY ISH. ...')
